FUNCTION CLAMP_SCORE(X)
    IF (X < 0) THEN
    CLAMP_SCORE = 0
  ELSE
    CLAMP_SCORE = X
  END IF
  IF (X > 50) THEN
    CLAMP_SCORE = 50
  END IF
CLAMP_SCORE = CLAMP_SCORE
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION IS_PASSING(X)
    IF (CLAMP_SCORE(X) >= 45) THEN
    IS_PASSING = 1
  ELSE
    IS_PASSING = 0
  END IF
IS_PASSING = IS_PASSING
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION SCORE_CLASS(X)
    IF (CLAMP_SCORE(X) < 20) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 0
  ELSE
    SCORE_CLASS = 1
  END IF
  IF (IS_PASSING(X) = 1) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 2
  END IF
SCORE_CLASS = SCORE_CLASS
END FUNCTION
